rooms.name: Forest Edge
rooms.description:
The dirt road ends at a dark treeline.
Pine and oak crowd close, and birdsong gives way to hush.
The valley road runs west, and a game trail winds east deeper
into the woods.

rooms.name: Forest Heart
rooms.description:
Ancient trunks crowd close, and the light falls green.
The trail runs west back toward the valley and east to a
quiet clearing.

rooms.name: Forest Clearing
rooms.description:
A quiet clearing opens to the sky.
Wildflowers nod among the stumps of fallen trees, and the
heart of the forest lies west. Brambles pile thick to the
south, half-hiding a dark cleft in the rock.

rooms.name: Bear Cavern
rooms.description:
A shallow cavern reeks of musk and old bones.
Scratched earth and a trampled nest fill the back. The forest
clearing lies north — and something large is breathing in the dark.

npcs.name: Old Cave Bear
description: A massive bear with a scarred muzzle and matted dark fur.
It watches you warily, guarding its den.
npcs.room_description: A massive bear lurks here, guarding the cavern.
